items.title: Are Capital One’s Travel Tuesday deals worth booking?
items.why: Weekly portal offers keep cardholders engaged with travel perks, a useful benchmark for partner-funded travel promotions.
items.summary_ai: Capital One's Travel Tuesday deals offer a free fourth night, 30% off select hotels and Hertz savings, with eligibility varying by offer.
items.take: Weekly portal offers keep cardholders engaged with travel perks, a useful benchmark for partner-funded travel promotions.
